items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I know Buddy P.T., he used to play up here at the Palm Garden

ctx.x: I was going to ask you where some of the best bands played in New Orleans. What would be some of the halls and places like that?

What do you mean? Here in New Orleans? Uh-huh. Well, now, during the time I lived here, I didn't go out very much to very many dances, because now, they used to have a dance place up here on Danille Street they called a Palm Garden, and this Buddy P.T. It wasn't Buddy P.T. He had a band there, but I didn't go very often, but I went up there once or twice. He had a band there. Now, this Arobishow, it seemed like to me he played at St. Catherine Hall. And then, uh, on the Ruth Garden, I can't remember what this…
Let's get the address down here. This is 1926 Harmony.
